patch_description:
The current plan only has two modes, with the robot standing still and one additional mode where the right hand and foot are touching the floor. This is insufficient to navigate through clutter and reach the final position. By adding a walking sequence, the robot can move through the cluttered environment and reach the desired location.

The plan will start by standing still, then add a walking sequence to move forward, avoiding obstacles like tables and boxes. Finally, it will ensure that the robot is standing on the floor with the desired base position.
